title: India-based EloElo, whose Story TV microdrama app has 33M+ estimated active users, raised an $80M Series C led by Hornbill Capital and NBCU at a $500M valuation (Ivan Mehta/TechCrunch)
summary: Ivan Mehta / TechCrunch: India-based EloElo, whose Story TV microdrama app has 33M+ estimated active users, raised an $80M Series C led by Hornbill Capital and NBCU at a $500M valuation — More than 118 million users watch microdramas every month as the serialized format has taken off in India.
